final: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM (SELECT rating, rental_count * 1.0 / SUM(rental_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(rental_count * 1.0 / SUM(rental_count) OVER ()) OVER () AS avg_share FROM (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating)) WHERE share > avg_share
